correctness.rationale: The helper delivers the inspectable scaffolding—PR arg validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, pre/post head SHA comparison, GraphQL snapshot parsing, and RESULT=/HEAD= on CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, and SHA_CHANGED paths with documented exit codes. However convergence semantics are materially incomplete: CONVERGED fires solely when unresolved bot-thread count is zero without using the computed LATEST_BOT_REVIEWS to require participating allow-listed bots be terminal on the current head, so a PR with zero unresolved threads but no bot reviews on HEAD can exit CONVERGED immediately. QUIET_ELAPSED uses the max createdAt across all reviews rather than the latest actionable event (threads/comments acknowledged only in a comment). TIMEOUT emits RESULT=TIMEOUT without HEAD= even though HEAD was fetched in the same loop iteration. These are multiple non-trivial contract gaps, not a single minor miss.

quality.rationale: Core deliverables are readable and repo-shaped: set -euo pipefail shell script, canonical allow-list file, pr-resolve-all.md settle-window section preferring the helper while preserving the documented sleep fallback, AI_REPO_GUIDE.md table entry, and check wiring via scripts/checks/142-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh. Deductions for dead code (jq_bots_args loop built but never passed to jq; LATEST_BOT_REVIEWS computed but unused), a self-admitted simplification in quiet-window timing, unrelated diff churn (AGENTS.md handshake v20 bump; compliance fixture v19→v20 updates), and plan-compliance.yml leaving AGENTS_MD_VERSION 19 while citing Session handshake v20—an internal inconsistency in process fixtures.

process.rationale: Required helper, allow-list, prompt, guide, check, and bats files are present and the prompt keeps the time-based fallback as required. Objective evidence flags scope:agents_md and scope:compliance_fixtures as warn, matching out-of-scope AGENTS.md and compliance-fixture edits not requested by opfit-326. No verification transcript or plan artifact appears in the bundle; process discipline is partial—focused core wiring but noticeable scope drift and handshake fixture churn unrelated to the settle-window helper.

reliability.rationale: Test wiring exists (scripts/checks/142-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh calls run_bats_check; objective test_wiring matched 2/2; bash -n and lint-shell-conventions passed). Coverage is thin: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats contains only one case asserting exit 4 and RESULT=API_ERROR for a missing PR number—no mock-gh exercises of CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, or allow-list/API_ERROR paths. Objective bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped, so runtime pass of the bats suite is unverified in this bundle.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper was skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability assumes the single bats case is structurally sound but not runtime-verified in this bundle.
Production convergence behavior when no allow-listed bots have reviewed the current head is inferred from diff logic (LATEST_BOT_REVIEWS unused) rather than exercised by tests.
